proofProvider.evidence: Opaque fixture ID matched against immutable body digest and issuer/role/epoch tuple

replayPolicy.nonce: Receiver-generated, single use within durable ledger; bounded volatile challenges
replayPolicy.sequence: Strictly increasing safe integer per source principal within policy/receiver ledger; gaps allowed, no reset on restart
replayPolicy.restart: No outstanding challenge or data admission restored; explicit fresh challenge/claim required
replayPolicy.receipt: Only one receiver COMMIT and one sender RECEIPT per transfer; read-only reconciliation is a separate operation
replayPolicy.commitTime: Must precede source admission expiry, even when sender receives archival receipt later

storage.ledger: Canonical exclusive append plus file and directory fsync
storage.anchor: Separate append-only mock frontier; mismatch HOLD, no repair

scope.transport: Mock calls and subprocess replay only, no retrofit of R72 HTTP API
scope.receiver72: Unmodified package semantic/readback verifier in new fixture namespaces
